Khador the Rowdy

Biography

A former warrior under Gort, Khador fell out with his commander and now welcomes the chance to fight beside Zak. His eagerness for battle is more prominent than any grand cause. He stays associated with the village and warns that a crowded party would get in the way of his axe. [1, 2, 3]
